@lru_cache(maxsize=1024 * 128)
def _path_to_elements(path, root_element=DEFAULT_FIRST_ELEMENT):
    if path is None:
        return []
    
    elements = []
    
    # Convert path to string if needed
    path = str(path)
    
    # We'll parse character by character
    current = ''
    inside = None  # None, '[', '.'
    in_quote = None  # None, "'", '"'
    i = 0
    
    while i < len(path):
        char = path[i]
        
        if in_quote:
            if char == in_quote:
                in_quote = None
            current += char
            i += 1
        elif char in ('"', "'"):
            in_quote = char
            current += char
            i += 1
        elif char == '[':
            if current:
                _add_to_elements(elements, current, inside if inside else '.')
                current = ''
            inside = '['
            i += 1
        elif char == ']':
            _add_to_elements(elements, current, inside)
            current = ''
            inside = None
            i += 1
        elif char == '.':
            if current:
                _add_to_elements(elements, current, inside if inside else '.')
                current = ''
            inside = '.'
            i += 1
        else:
            current += char
            i += 1
    
    # Handle any remaining current
    if current:
        _add_to_elements(elements, current, inside if inside else '.')
    
    if root_element is None:
        # Skip the root element
        return tuple(elements[1:]) if len(elements) > 1 else tuple()
    
    if elements:
        # Replace the first element (root) with the provided root_element
        elements[0] = root_element
    elif root_element:
        elements.append(root_element)
    
    return tuple(elements)
